name: collector-mcp
description: Read-only MCP server for Solana collectibles: Metaplex Core ownership history, who can freeze or burn an item, marketplace sales and floors that keep their currency and source. No sign-up.
author: p1xel (https://p1xel.app)

scripts.build: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run lint && node test/protocol.mjs && node test/market.mjs && node test/das.mjs && node test/mechanics.mjs && node test/hardening.mjs && node test/wrong-answers.mjs && node test/autokey.mjs && node test/credentials-and-cancellation.mjs && node test/census.mjs && node test/escrow-and-dedupe.mjs && node test/roles-and-holes.mjs && node test/siblings.mjs && node test/abuse.mjs && node test/identity-and-validation.mjs && node test/release-checks.mjs && node test/robustness.mjs && node scripts/build-architecture.mjs --check
scripts.test:battery: npm run build && node test/battery.mjs && node test/battery2.mjs && node test/battery3.mjs
